FORM NO. 3
G. 65M-1.39
HSY

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. / Adm. 9355
Date... Oct. 11... 19 39...

Subject (in full) ITK, Emil, 40, German Jewish refugee.

Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by C. Crawford

ITK, EMIL, 40, German Jewish refugee,
commission agent in precious metals, glassware,
chinaware, musical instruments, toys, photo supplies
etc. has two rooms above Cafe Class, 109
Broadway West, in which he conducts his not too
flourishing business affairs.

In July of the current year ITK, EMI was
involved in a criminal case in Wayside District and
following investigations by detectives (Vice Wayside
C.I.D. 8/8/39), was proceeded against by summons for
having knowingly received stolen property, to wit, one
camera valued at 200. He was found not guilty
on appearance before the S.D. Court.

P. Q. & D. C. (a)
J. Pitts
D. S.
D. C. (Special Branch)

（印：PERSONAL DEPT 12 AUG.）

HSY

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科第1股
报告
上海公共租界
特别支部登记处
编号 S. B. / Adm. 9355
日期……1939年10月11日……

事由（全称） ITK, Emil，40岁，德籍犹太难民。

呈报人 D. S. Pitts 转呈人 C. Crawford

ITK, EMIL，40岁，德籍犹太难民，
从事贵金属、玻璃器皿、
瓷器、乐器、玩具、摄影器材等商品的佣金代理业务，
在西百老汇路109号 Class 咖啡馆楼上拥有两间房间，
他在此经营其并不景气的生意。

在今年七月，ITK, EMI 卷入了一起发生在韦斯特区（Wayside District）的刑事案件，
经侦探调查（韦斯特区副探长，刑事侦缉处，1939年8月8日），
他被以传票方式起诉，罪名是明知故犯地收受赃物，即一部价值200元的照相机。
他在特区法院出庭受审时被判无罪。

P. Q. & D. C. (a)
J. Pitts
D. S.
D. C. （特别支部）

（印章：人事科 8月12日）

M 9/11

WITKOWSKI & CO
1093 Broadway East
Shanghai, July 26, 1939.

Sirs,
We take the liberty to inform you that we established
the firm
Witkowski and Co.
Proprietors Edgar Goetzi and Leopold Witkowski
in order to make business of every kind of used wares
(commissioners) we should be glad to get a statement from
you about our announcement.

Faithfully

Edgar Goetzi    Leopold Witkowski
pages.zh:
M 9/11

WITKOWSKI & CO
东百老汇路1093号
上海，1939年7月26日。

先生们：
我们冒昧通知贵方，我们已成立
Witkowski and Co. 公司
业主为 Edgar Goetzi 和 Leopold Witkowski
旨在开展各类二手商品的经纪业务（佣金代理），如蒙贵方就我们的公告给予回复，我们将不胜感激。

此致

Edgar Goetzi    Leopold Witkowski
